name: JM BodyWeave — Independent Estate Backup & Common-Thread Foundry
purpose: Provide an independent recovery witness for the JM estate, preserve each source body and lineage, identify genuine common threads, house related bodies without flattening them, and compile larger usable descendant bodies with reversible routes back to every contributor.
keeper: Mesh does not mean merge. Compilation does not erase composition.

layers.name: Source Estate
layers.meaning: Chats, Projects, Library files, Wisebase records, GitHub sources, OPEN_FIRST carriers, packages and receipts used as recoverable evidence.

layers.name: Body Register
layers.meaning: Distinct creations, strongest presently evidenced forms, states, roles, aliases and authority routes.

layers.name: Common-Thread Houses
layers.meaning: Related bodies grouped by an evidenced operating thread while identity and differences remain visible.

layers.name: Grander Byproducts
layers.meaning: Additional descendant systems, engines, carriers or architectures made possible by the housed bodies together.

common_thread_houses.name: Contact, Aim & Interaction House
common_thread_houses.common_thread: A user must be able to aim, touch, select, manipulate and leave a persistent editable contact record without the finger, pointer, target and proof body collapsing into one thing.
common_thread_houses.combined_route: AIM → PREVIEW → SELECT → GRAB/ACTIVATE → ADJUST → RELEASE → COMMIT → PIN/REPLAY → RECEIPT

common_thread_houses.name: Communication & Expression House
common_thread_houses.common_thread: Meaning travels through words, sound, hands, mouth, face, body, visual form and interactive signals; no single carrier owns the whole message.
must_remain_separate: gesture ≠ sign language as a whole
common_thread_houses.combined_route: SOURCE INTENT → CARRIER(S) → SIGNAL SHAPE → CONTACT FIELD → RECIPIENT READING → CORRECTION → TRACE → RE-EXPRESSION

common_thread_houses.name: Form, Position, Movement & Route House
common_thread_houses.common_thread: Form can carry quantity, position, direction, route, joining, enclosure and movement as visible operating structure.
must_remain_separate: numeric zero N₀ ≠ origin field Q₀
common_thread_houses.combined_route: ORIGIN FIELD → AVAILABLE POSITIONS → DECLARED DIRECTION → ROUTE → TRAVELLER/OPERATOR → MOVEMENT → CONTACT/JOIN → TRACE/FORM

common_thread_houses.name: Continuity, Recovery & Re-entry House
common_thread_houses.common_thread: A body must survive chat failure, version change, platform movement and later retrieval without being rebuilt from memory or flattened into a summary.
must_remain_separate: lineage preservation ≠ keeping every version active
common_thread_houses.combined_route: MENTION → RECALL → LOCATE PROOF → IDENTIFY CURRENT ACCESS → RESTORE → VERIFY → PACKAGE → REGISTER → RE-ENTER → CONTINUE

common_thread_houses.name: Game-Creation & Runtime Production House
common_thread_houses.common_thread: Different game identities can share governed organs for meaning, assets, mapping, runtime, production and proof without becoming clones.
must_remain_separate: shared engine organ ≠ shared game identity
common_thread_houses.combined_route: SOURCE MEANING/MECHANIC → PLAYFORM LOOP → KADING MAP → GLYPHPLAY LOGIC → GLYPHFORGE ASSET/ADAPTER → GAME NATIVE CORE → GAMEFORGE BUILD → GAMECORE SHARED QA → DEVICE TRACE

common_thread_houses.name: Participation, Proof & Transformation House
common_thread_houses.common_thread: Possibility, understanding and claimed change become rateable only through bodies, conditions, action, contact, trace, pressure, correction and recoverable outcome.
common_thread_houses.combined_route: AIM/POSSIBILITY → BODY + FIELD → ACTION/PARTICIPATION → CONTACT → TRACE → VALIDATE → STRESS/PUSHBACK → REVISE → TRANSFORM → RECOVER/REUSE

grander_byproducts.name: JM ContactBody Interaction Runtime
grander_byproducts.what_it_adds: A reusable interaction layer where finger movement controls a persistent pointer, contact creates editable pinned records, aim marks survive release, and the same grammar can move across apps, games and physical grips.
first_outputs: persistent cursor and editable contact-mark component
grander_byproducts.proof_gate: Must be grafted into at least two distinct rebuilt bodies without either body losing its own identity.

grander_byproducts.name: JM Living Expression Carrier
grander_byproducts.state: TEST-RUN COMPILED / READER AND TOOL ROUTES OPEN
grander_byproducts.what_it_adds: A carrier-neutral expression system that can preserve and compare intended function across speech, text, hand, face, sound, visual form and interactive response.
grander_byproducts.proof_gate: The same intended function must survive at least three different carriers while differences and losses remain visible.

grander_byproducts.name: JM FormRoute Runtime
grander_byproducts.kind: visible form, number, position and movement engine
grander_byproducts.what_it_adds: A single inspectable runtime grammar for forming quantity, declaring fields, locating positions, selecting routes and tracing movement through centre, arms, diagonals and enclosures.
grander_byproducts.proof_gate: One source form must execute as a visual diagram, a movement route and a machine-readable state without collapsing those outputs into sameness.

grander_byproducts.name: JM Independent Re-entry Architecture
grander_byproducts.state: TEST-RUN ACTIVE — BODYWEAVE IS FIRST RECIPIENT
grander_byproducts.what_it_adds: A second recoverable route that can reconstruct what exists, where it lives, what is strongest, how it relates and how to continue even when the original chat or register fails.
grander_byproducts.proof_gate: A later chat or operator must recover a selected body and its current next action using BodyWeave without returning to First Stage.

grander_byproducts.name: JM Sovereign Game Production Stack
grander_byproducts.what_it_adds: A governed production route from source mechanic and meaning through playable logic, asset adaptation, native runtime, build production, shared QA and device proof.
grander_byproducts.proof_gate: At least two rebuilt games must share organs while remaining mechanically and visually distinct.

grander_byproducts.name: JM Participation-to-Transformation Engine
grander_byproducts.kind: cross-domain testing, correction and change system
grander_byproducts.what_it_adds: A joined route for moving from possibility or desired change through bodily participation, declared conditions, contact, trace, validation, stress, revision and evidenced transformation.
grander_byproducts.proof_gate: Must produce at least one practical change case while clearly separating observed result, inferred mechanism and unresolved uncertainty.

incoming_update_contract.purpose: Receive significant progress from the separate rebuild chat without crowning by message or version number alone.
required_fields: whether a Grander Byproduct is strengthened, corrected or split
incoming_update_contract.route: REBUILD OUTPUT → SOURCE RECEIPT → CURRENT-BEST COMPARISON → BODY REGISTER UPDATE → HOUSE RELATION UPDATE → BYPRODUCT PRESSURE TEST → ACCEPT / HOLD / REJECT / SPLIT
incoming_update_contract.guard: A significant rebuild can strengthen BodyWeave immediately, but it cannot erase prior lineage or crown itself without the declared proof gate.

test_run_result.next_valid_action: Run wider estate ingestion and accept significant rebuilt-body receipts from the production chat.

boundaries: This is a working test run, not a claim that every accessible estate body has been recovered.
The six byproducts are additional descendants, not replacements for their component bodies.
Body names and strongest forms remain open to correction by exact source and newer receipts.
No app, game, tool, theory, package or public route is crowned merely by inclusion.
JM Estate Compass, Estate Head, First Stage, Bringing It All Together and Theory Multihub remain distinct source and operating bodies.
